known_analogues: Uniform polynomial formulas for figurate numbers
proof_mechanisms: 1. Use three anchor points (26,99),(36,175),(43,209) to determine a,b,c in ax^2+bx+c
3. Verify residuals on all 18 training rows
4. If max error > 0 then reject or refine
claim.statement: Several parents tried polynomial fits but with wrong degree or domain. The training data from x0=26..43 has outputs growing roughly quadratically. A single global quadratic might suffice. Using three well-spaced anchors: f(26)=99, f(36)=175, f(43)=209, solving gives a≈0.1741, b≈-0.5289, c≈-3.167. This is compact and falsifiable.
